title: 第16章 买卡
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
其实，林峰也没见过制卡师，更不清楚卡牌是怎么制作出来的。

    但他知道，只有制卡师才能弄出品质更高的卡牌，所以林奇这手融合卡牌的能力，在他眼里就是制卡师的专属技能。

    林奇拿起那张泛着绿光的骷髅勇士卡牌，在林峰眼前晃了晃。

    “爹，融合这张二星绿色卡，我只用了五张一星骷髅小兵卡，成本也就一千五百卡恩。

    可在万卡阁，一张二星绿色召唤卡起码能卖三千卡恩，我们卖一张就能赚一千五百卡恩！你觉得咱家的奇妙物语商铺，要不要增加卖卡业务？”

    “加，必须得加！”

    林峰一听这话，瞬间来了精神，一个鲤鱼打挺从地上站起来。

    此时他的脊柱挺得笔直，像极了翻身农奴把歌唱。

    “回头我就去佣兵团找老弟兄们，给他们推销佣兵佩剑！还有这骷髅勇士，能打能抗，肯定也是好帮手！”

    林奇笑着点头，心里却还有一层顾虑。

    他看着林峰，认真地提醒道：“爹，有件事得跟你说清楚。到时候要是有人问你，这些卡牌是从哪来的，你就说是你自己制作的，千万别提我。”

    “啊？”

    林峰一脸惊讶，伸手指了指自己的鼻子。

    “我制作的？可我连制卡的材料都认不全啊！”

    林奇早就想好了说辞。

    “你就对外宣称，十年前你遇到一位隐居的制卡大师，被他收为弟子，这些年一直在石铁城偷偷苦练，现在终于学有所成，能制作卡牌了。”

    林峰挠了挠后脑勺，还是有些不自信。

    “这说法会有人信吗？”

    林奇一脸笃定，“肯定会信，因为你有这个资质。”

    “啊！是吗？”

    林峰都不知道，自己在儿子心中竟然是这么一副伟岸的形象。

    “当然。自从十年前你突破四星御卡师，之后再也没有突破的动静。

    正常御卡师哪怕资质差到是一条咸鱼，十年间也该蹦跶蹦跶了。

    而老爹你就如同磐石一般坚固，一点源力不见增长，这就是你最好的说辞啊！”

    “呃……”

    林峰听得一愣一愣的。

    这话听着怎么都不像夸人，可仔细一想，好像还真有道理。

    他张了张嘴，最后只能无奈地答应。

    “行吧，就按你说的来！”

    林奇拍了拍他的肩膀，语气变得严肃起来。

    “老爹，我不是让你瞎吹牛。你假扮制卡大师的弟子，能给咱家营造一种背后有人的感觉，这样我们卖卡才安全。

    毕竟石铁城以前只有万卡阁一家卖卡的，我们突然插进来，相当于抢他们的生意，要是没点背景，肯定会被找麻烦。”

    林奇把其中的利害关系说得明明白白，林峰这才彻底醒悟过来。

    他握紧拳头，眼神里满是坚定。
content_en:
In fact, Lin Feng has never seen a card maker, and he has no idea how the cards are made.

    But he knew that only card makers could produce higher-quality cards, so Lynch's ability to fuse cards was, in his eyes, the exclusive skill of card makers.

    Lin Qi picked up the green-glow Skeleton Warrior card and waved it in front of Lin Feng's eyes.

    "Dad, to fuse this two-star green card, I only used five one-star skeleton minion cards, and the cost was only 1,500 Karns.

    But in Wanka Pavilion, a two-star green summoning card can be sold for at least 3,000 Karns, and we can earn 1,500 Karns by selling one! Do you think our Wonderful Story store should increase its card sales business? "

    "Add, must add!"

    When Lin Feng heard this, he immediately became energetic and stood up from the ground like a carp.

    At this time, his spine was straight, like a serf who had turned over and sang.

    "I will go to the mercenary group to find the old brothers and sell them mercenary swords! And this skeleton warrior can fight and resist, so he must be a good helper!"

    Lin Qi smiled and nodded, but there was still a layer of worry in his heart.

    He looked at Lin Feng and reminded seriously: "Dad, I have to tell you something clearly. If someone asks you where these cards come from, just say that you made them yourself, and never mention me."

    "Huh?"

    Lin Feng looked surprised and pointed at his nose.

    "I made it? But I don't even know all the materials needed to make the card!"

    Lynch had already thought of his words.

    "Just declare to the outside world that you met a reclusive card-making master ten years ago and was accepted as his disciple. You have been secretly practicing hard in Shitie City for these years. Now you have finally learned enough and can make cards."

    Lin Feng scratched the back of his head, still a little unsure.

    "Will anyone believe this statement?"

    Lynch looked confident, "I will definitely believe it because you have the qualifications."

    "Ah! Really?"

    Lin Feng didn't even know that he had such a majestic image in his son's heart.

    "Of course. Since you broke through to the four-star card master ten years ago, there has been no news of a breakthrough since then.

    A normal card master, even if his qualifications are as poor as a salted fish, would be able to bounce back in ten years.

    And dad, you are as solid as a rock, and your strength has not increased at all. This is your best excuse! "

    "Uh..."

    Lin Feng was stunned for a moment after hearing this.

    This doesn't sound like a compliment, but if you think about it carefully, it seems to make sense.

    He opened his mouth and finally had no choice but to agree.

    "Okay, just do as you say!"

    Lynch patted his shoulder and his tone became serious.

    "Dad, I'm not asking you to brag. By pretending to be a disciple of the master card maker, you can give our family the feeling that there is someone behind us, so that it is safe for us to sell cards.

    After all, Shi Tiecheng used to be the only one selling cards in Wanka Pavilion. If we suddenly stepped in, it would be equivalent to robbing their business. If we didn’t have some background, we would definitely get into trouble. "

    Lin Qi clearly explained the stakes, and Lin Feng finally came to his senses.

    He clenched his fists, his eyes full of determination.
